# Recorded driving against the live driver

Capture-clock samples at 30 Hz; no interpolation across missing frames. Controller states are held until the next event. Pilot self-check is excluded from human totals.

The lead is fitted to changes in route-relative visual heading, independently of driver commands. All response-lag fits are provisional; geometry changes can confound them. GPS speed is a causal distance slope, not a ground-truth speedometer. Lateral acceleration is an ahead-path proxy using the driver's 0.7 metres/pixel scale, not measured vehicle acceleration.

Clear moments require a same-sign stick of at least 0.3 for at least 0.3 s. Moment agreement means the same direction for more than half the moment; the seconds-weighted share is reported separately. Curvature bins are >=0.01 inverse pixels for bends and <0.005 for straights. Lift timing is measured before crossing the ahead-path bend threshold, not before physical entry to a bend.

Pedal shares use raw recorded controls: full R2 >=0.95, lifted R2 <=0.05, braking L2 >0.05. Pilot pedal output has a hardware profile and is not equated with Driver throttle.
